
### Files

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-installer.sh` | The installer for Linux and WSL 2: piped into `sh`, as the README's line does, it takes the archive for the machine, checks it and installs it. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-macos-installer.sh` | The installer for macOS, the same script as the one for Linux. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-windows-installer.ps1` | The installer for Windows: run in PowerShell, as the README's line does, it takes the zip, checks it and installs it. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-x64.tar.gz` | The program for Linux on an Intel or AMD processor, with its license, README and changelog, in a folder of the same name: to unpack by hand. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | The same for Linux on Arm. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | The program for macOS on Apple silicon. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-macos-x64.tar.gz` | The program for macOS on Intel. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-windows-x64.zip` | The program for Windows on an Intel or AMD processor. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-x64.deb`, `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-arm64.deb` | Packages for Debian and Ubuntu. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-x64.rpm`, `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-arm64.rpm` | Packages for Fedora and openSUSE. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-x64.apk`, `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-arm64.apk` | Packages for Alpine. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-x64.pkg.tar.zst`, `zellij-reaper-@V@-linux-arm64.pkg.tar.zst` | Packages for Arch. |
| `zellij-reaper-@V@-checksums.txt` | The SHA-256 of every file above, to check one downloaded by hand. |
